reason: The cited evidence (E1) confirms the octonary nanoparticles have an ordered intermetallic structure and show high EOR activity/durability, but it provides no data on d-band centers, adjacent site electronic modulation, or the specific mechanistic role of copper. The key premises about electronic structure and the proposed mechanism are therefore unsupported by the cited passage.
premises: Octonary MPEI nanoparticles have an ordered intermetallic structure
The ordered intermetallic structure creates adjacent sites with different d-band centers
Adjacent sites with different d-band centers enable optimized adsorption/dehydrogenation sequence
This optimized sequence minimizes CO poisoning and supports full 12-electron oxidation
Selective removal of copper will shift the d-band center and impair intermediate binding
